finalists.label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has the strongest for evidence, including a clonal IgH gene rearrangement and dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has a broad range of for evidence, including elevated white blood cell count, inguinal lymphadenopathy, fatigue, weight loss, and loss of appetite, as well as dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes and clonal IgH gene rearrangement.

finalists.label: Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma
finalists.why: This candidate has some for evidence, including glans penis and corona edema and dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, but is weakened by the presence of a clonal IgH gene rearrangement, which is more characteristic of B-cell lymphoma.

frontier_selector.why: The champion, Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, is chosen because it has the most specific and decisive for evidence, including a clonal IgH gene rearrangement and dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+, within the background of a reactive T-cell infiltrate, which are characteristic of this disease.
